To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the design of a sprinkler irrigation system is a multi-criterion problem, where the main objective is to minimize the annual water cost (CT), which includes investment and operation costs.
the design of the sprinkler irrigation subunits with minimum water cost can be obtained using the MATLAB™ software, PRESUD.

the design of sprinkler irrigation subunits using the MATLAB™ software named PRESSUD can help to identify the optimum design with a criterion for minimum annual water application costs (CT), which is defined as the annual cost per cubic meter water applied for crop use.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the design of sprinkler irrigation subunits of minimum cost, which is an alternative to the traditional approach, and it is also an alternative to the design of subunits based on a single objective (e.g. uniformity) and to the design of sprinklers subunits of maximum water savings.
the design of a sprinkler irrigation system with a minimum annual water application cost.
the design of sprinkler irrigation subunits, with the objective of minimizing the annual cost of water applied to crops, taking into account the operation of the subunit.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
, in order to obtain the minimum CT, it is necessary to take into consideration all the variables that make up CT and not to use a criterion based on a single factor.
the use of PRESUD is recommended for designing sprinkler irrigation subunits, and that the criterion Δh < 15 % is the best for achieving the minimum CT.

PRESUD is an excellent tool to design a sprinkler irrigation system with a minimum cost, and the use and application of PRESUD can help to obtain better solutions than using the criterion Δh < 15 % and Δh <20 %.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the PRESUD tool is an easy-to-use and useful tool for identifying the optimum sprinkler subunit design.
the use of the PRESUD software can help to obtain better solutions in terms of the annual water application costs.

PRESUD is a tool that can help to obtain the best design solution, which will be the minimum CT, and that this tool can be applied to any crop, soil and climate, and to any type of irrigation subunit, whether it is a solid set sprinkler, a drip or a surface irrigation system.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the design of a sprinkler irrigation system should be done by a professional engineer, and the results of such design should be used as the starting point for the design of the sprinkler irrigation system, and not as the end result.

the design of a sprinkler irrigation system is not only a question of the investment and operation cost of the irrigation subunit but also of the water cost, which is the main factor of the annual cost of the sprinkler irrigation subunits.
, when using the PRESUD software, the user must be very careful with the input data, especially the values for the energy costs and the water cost (Cws).
